_doc: Inukai Hayate's lines (docs/CAST.md). Episode 0 week-2 rival by default. {player} = the protagonist.

low: Yo, transfer student! You look like you need running. Everyone needs running.
Oi, {player}! Lunch? Roof? Track? All three?
mid: There you are! I saved you a yakisoba bread. I ate half. Saved is a strong word.
Walk you home later? Not because I'm worried. Okay, a bit because I'm worried.
high: {player}! Best friend! Don't tell anyone I said best friend.
You know you can tell me stuff, right? Even weird stuff. Especially weird stuff.

stage_lines.1: Man... I keep dreaming a cat's sitting on me. Heavy little thing. Smells like rain.
stage_lines.2: Someone threw my shoes in the pond. Who does that? There were paw prints. Paw prints, {player}!
stage_lines.3: Is it just me or do the cats hate me now? Dogs love me. Cats used to tolerate me.
stage_lines.4: Uh... sorry, have we talked before? You look familiar. Weird.

choices.hang: "Yakisoba bread on the roof? My treat. ...Your treat."
choices.warn: "Hayate. Stay away from cats this week. I'm serious."
choices.shrine: "Tell me about the dog shrine again. The night-road thing."

hang: You run three laps for no reason and eat melon bread on the bleachers. It's nice. Somewhere behind the bleachers, a bell jingles.
He teaches you a stretch that 'fixes everything'. It fixes nothing. You laugh anyway.
warn_first: "Cats? Ha! I'm an Inukai, {player}. Dog shrine. Cats are scared of ME." He stops laughing. "...Okay. I'll keep my window shut."
warn_again: "Window's shut, salt's on the sill. My dad gave me a look when I asked for it. A long look."
shrine: "Our shrine's for the okuri-inu. Dogs that walk travellers home at night. Dad says we walk the dead home at Obon. I just walk you home. Same thing, kind of."
"Dad says the cat shrine and the dog shrine haven't spoken in a hundred years. Something about a promise. He won't say whose."
bye: "I'll walk you to the gate. No arguments."
